In addition to TCMIH primarily non-emergency inter-facility services, TCMIH will routinely render ambulance services in response to facility requests that fall into the Center for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) guidelines qualifying Twin City for reimbursement under the CMS code for ALS or BLS Emergency based on the "Immediate Response" criteria. The current CMS
definition for Emergency is not based on "lights and sirens", it is based on "immediate response".
